title: log-shapes
description: The Player.log formats that mods (not the game) print, as format templates. A template is literal text with typed placeholders written {name:type}; name is [a-z][a-z_]{0,31} and unique within the template, type is one of text (one or more characters, spaces allowed), token (one or more non-space characters), int (one or more ASCII digits) or hex (1 to 16 hex digits); a literal brace is written {{ or }}. A template matches the whole trimmed line. Limits Rimmerge enforces when it loads a row (a row over a limit is ignored): at most 512 bytes and 8 placeholders per template, at least 4 bytes of literal text, at most 8 rows per role, at most 32 bytes for a plain string. Required placeholders per template: start needs mod; the stack block trailer needs path; head and dimensions need path, and dimensions also width, height and format; original and stub need id. One array per role; a role this schema does not list is not read by an older Rimmerge.

patch_stack_blocks.description: A patch-reporting mod's stack-trace block: a start line, the operation lines, an end line, and an optional trailing source-file line.

start.description: The block's first line; must capture the mod's name as {mod:text}.

end.description: The block's last line, usually with no placeholder (an exact match).

trailer.description: The optional line after the end line; must capture {path:text}.

xpath_detail_prefix.description: What an operation line's parenthesized detail starts with when it names an xpath.

texture_fallbacks.description: A texture loader's fallback: a head line saying a compressed texture failed to load, and a trailer line saying the PNG was used instead.

head.description: Any head line of the fallback; must capture {path:text}.

dimensions.description: The head line's form that reports the texture's size; must capture path, {width:int}, {height:int} and {format:token}.

trailer.description: The line that follows the head.

stack_back_references.description: A patching library's back-reference: a stack trace printed once under an id, and later repeats that only name the id.

original.description: The line that names the original trace; must capture {id:hex}.

stub.description: The line that repeats it; must capture {id:hex}.
